scopeLabel: Source-scoped preparation, characterization, sensing and computational evidence from the admitted eight-page main article and 26-page SI. Explicit source variants and contradictions are retained. Cited upstream papers are not admitted. Computational ZnS structures are models, not measured nanocrystal phases or coordinates.

availability.morphology_illustration: Source images and reported observations are retained. No finite particle, ligand interface or atomic arrangement is reconstructed from incomplete geometry or unknown physical batch identity. Calculated ZnS models are not measured QD structures.

bindings.caption: Mix OH516, CX544 and OMe608 dispersions. Three source-named dispersions are combined; their mixing ratios and individual aliquots are not reported. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

Titrate the multichannel array with each analyte. Same source titration concentration series as single-channel assays. Five wavelengths monitor three peaks and two overlap regions. Conceptual action illustration. No unreported dimensions, quantitative liquid level, pressure, atmosphere or measured particle geometry is implied.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
